{{Top|leg}}
A '''Flatcam''' was a portable recording device used by the [[Adumari]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]] . It was technologically behind more commonly used [[Holocamera/Legends|holocams]], being only able to record and portray two dimensional images.<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
